answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 21526 Country: India Title: pls tell me wearing diamond with silver is permissible or not....? Question: assalamalekum....pls tell me wearing diamond with silver is permissible or not....? Answer ID: 21526 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 604/604/M=1431) For man a silver ring weighing less than one misqal is allowed. Using diamond gem is alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
